svg.title: discovery program
svg.desc: Mountains: a high peak with a snow line, a lower one behind, and the sun, cut from a green-600 tile. Drawn on the drawn-mark box and rules (docs/favicons/README.md): solid fills, no strokes, and every gap at least 2.5 units, which is about 1.4 CSS pixels at 16. Chosen 2026-11-07 from the owner's favorites; the ideas it was chosen from are in docs/prototypes/program-mark-ideas.html.
